environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in CI/CD cluster. The service runs as a pod with preStop hook sending SIGTERM. Database user 'pipeline_svc' has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the 'artifacts' database including audit_log table. Pod receives external traffic via NodePort service without ingress filtering. Container runs with default seccomp profile.

config.db_grants: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO pipeline_svc
